texts.preamble: M.Moorthi vs The Member Secretary on 5 June, 2025 In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 05.06.2025 Coram The Hon'Ble Mr.K.R.Shriram, Chief Justice And The Hon'Ble Mr.Justice Sunder Mohan W.P.No.24845 of 2024 and W.M.P.Nos.27197 of 2024 and 1309 of 2025 M.Moorthi . -vs- 1. (Rr7 and 8 are impleaded as per order dated 20.11.2024 in Wp.24845/2024) 9. The Commissioner of Food Safety, Office of the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration Department, 359, Anna Salai, Teynampet, Chennai 600 009. 10.Designated Officer, Food Safety Department, Chengalpet District. (Rr9 and 10 impleaded as per order dated 05.12.2024 in Wp.) .. Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind issuance of a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents 1 to 4 to appropriate action against the unauthorised construction put up by and 6th respondents of the commercial food court building running i name of Ellery Food Zone, consisting of 29 shops measuring to an extent of 7000 sq.ft. approximately situated at Nallambakkam Villag Vandalur Taluk, Chengalpattu District, comprised in Sruvey Nos.3/A2 3/A2C, 3/A2C2 abd 3/A2B measuring to an extent of 71 cents and to demolish the same.
